notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls more creatures than you.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Beza.
When Beza enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create two 1/1 Fish creature tokens, and a Treasure token if an opponent controls more lands than you.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Fish, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
